# Schemas
{: .no_toc}

Some resources carry a type-specific JSON payload validated against the JSON schema of the selected type. The selector field (usually `type`) picks the type; the payload field holds its properties. If the payload does not match the schema the API returns `400 Bad request` with the validation errors.

Every schema version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/<Family>/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/) for the URL layout and version history.

Some resources also validate one of their own JSON fields (additional fields, repository links, external identifiers, specifications) against a schema that does not depend on a type. Those schemas are documented on the resource's page: [`behavioralparadigm`](/api/taxonomies/behavioralparadigm/#json-field-schemas), [`datastorage`](/api/personal_attributes/datastorage/#json-field-schemas), [`project`](/api/stem/project/#json-field-schemas), [`session`](/api/stem/session/#json-field-schemas), [`setup`](/api/personal_attributes/setup/#json-field-schemas), [`species`](/api/taxonomies/species/#json-field-schemas), [`strain`](/api/taxonomies/strain/#json-field-schemas), [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/#json-field-schemas).

## Validation troubleshooting

- `type` not recognized: use one type code from the family's quick type map.
- Missing required property: add every property listed as required for that type.
- Wrong shape: quantities are objects with `value` and `unit`; multi-selects are lists of codes; tables are lists of row objects.
- Unit or option not accepted: use one of the codes listed under *Allowed values*.
- Unknown property: schemas reject properties they do not declare.
